onset.Description: Onset of the event in seconds relative to the start of the scan

duration.Description: Duration of the event in seconds

Levels.rest block: Fixation on a cross presented on a dark background.
Levels.stimulus display: Display of a flickering checkerboard stimulus.

stim_type.Description: Number on the presented flickering checkerboard within the active blocks

button_press.Description: Indicates which button was pressed during the stimulus presentation

Levels.g: Pressed the button for the right index finger.
Levels.f: Pressed the button for the right middle finger.
Levels.v: Pressed the button for the right ring finger.
Levels.b: Pressed the button for the right little finger.
